headline: Cracking Down on Stock Manipulation, IDX Brings In Special Team from Nasdaq
summary: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) is working with Nasdaq to strengthen trading surveillance and detect share manipulation. The cooperation is intended to support capital market reform and transparency.
why: Exchange surveillance rules shape investor confidence in listed markets, and enforcement against manipulation affects liquidity and valuations. Indonesia's IDX is the country's main equity venue.
original_headline: Berantas Manipulasi Saham, BEI Gandeng Tim Khusus dari Nasdaq
